degradation.disclosure.note: reduced-mode banner in Arabic and English

degradation.fallback_tested.note: fallback model configured; never exercised with a provider failure

integrity.bom.note: CycloneDX ML-BOM with the licence of each component

integrity.signature.note: weights pulled from a third-party mirror; no signature

objectives.latency.note: 99.5% availability and 95% under 2 s to first token, 30 days

objectives.quality_by_language.note: quality objective of 92%, measured on English samples only

release.canary_gate.note: canary at 10% for 30 minutes, latency gate only

release.rollback_tested.note: rollback drill 12 days before the review
